spans.text: The light that should have faded away has found its way back, thanks to you constantly pulling the stars to get them back on track.

units.rawText: Because this is the oath I made.
units.displayText: Because this is the oath I made.

spans.text: Because this is the oath I made.

units.rawText: I don't make promises easily, because I know there's a lot I can't do. But when I do promise something, there is nothing I won't do to keep it.
units.displayText: I don't make promises easily, because I know there's a lot I can't do. But when I do promise something, there is nothing I won't do to keep it.

spans.text: I don't make promises easily, because I know there's a lot I can't do. But when I do promise something, there is nothing I won't do to keep it.

units.rawText: Even if it keeps falling apart, over and over, like stars turning to dust?
units.displayText: Even if it keeps falling apart, over and over, like stars turning to dust?

spans.text: Even if it keeps falling apart, over and over, like stars turning to dust?

units.rawText: The girl looks down, not saying a word. I reach out, my fingers lightly touch her cheek, and gently tilt her face up to mine.
units.displayText: The girl looks down, not saying a word. I reach out, my fingers lightly touch her cheek, and gently tilt her face up to mine.

spans.text: The girl looks down, not saying a word. I reach out, my fingers lightly touch her cheek, and gently tilt her face up to mine.

units.rawText: Look at me.
units.displayText: Look at me.

spans.text: Look at me.

units.rawText: The young girl bites her lip and slowly looks up, meeting a pair of gentle eyes. Those eyes hold no blame or anger, just a deep well of love.
units.displayText: The young girl bites her lip and slowly looks up, meeting a pair of gentle eyes. Those eyes hold no blame or anger, just a deep well of love.

spans.text: The young girl bites her lip and slowly looks up, meeting a pair of gentle eyes. Those eyes hold no blame or anger, just a deep well of love.

units.rawText: I'll always be here with you, Hubble, protecting you and loving you. With everything I am, my body, my heart, my blood, my tears, my life, and my soul, until the very end of the universe.
units.displayText: I'll always be here with you, Hubble, protecting you and loving you. With everything I am, my body, my heart, my blood, my tears, my life, and my soul, until the very end of the universe.

spans.text: I'll always be here with you, Hubble, protecting you and loving you. With everything I am, my body, my heart, my blood, my tears, my life, and my soul, until the very end of the universe.

units.rawText: This promise is for you, the you from before, the you right now, and the you yet to come.
units.displayText: This promise is for you, the you from before, the you right now, and the you yet to come.

spans.text: This promise is for you, the you from before, the you right now, and the you yet to come.

units.rawText: I once again place the ring on her ring finger. Yet a familiar scene, similar actions, and still the same sincerity held within.
units.displayText: I once again place the ring on her ring finger. Yet a familiar scene, similar actions, and still the same sincerity held within.

spans.text: I once again place the ring on her ring finger. Yet a familiar scene, similar actions, and still the same sincerity held within.

units.rawText: Hubble's blue eyes fills with tears as she throws herself into my arms.
units.displayText: Hubble's blue eyes fills with tears as she throws herself into my arms.

spans.text: Hubble's blue eyes fills with tears as she throws herself into my arms.

units.rawText: Please hold me tight...
units.displayText: Please hold me tight...

spans.text: Please hold me tight...

units.rawText: She whispers in my ear. I do as she asks, hugging her a little closer.
units.displayText: She whispers in my ear. I do as she asks, hugging her a little closer.

spans.text: She whispers in my ear. I do as she asks, hugging her a little closer.

units.rawText: Thank you, for giving a dying star a place to call home.
units.displayText: Thank you, for giving a dying star a place to call home.

spans.text: Thank you, for giving a dying star a place to call home.

units.rawText: Even if we all end up as nothing in the end... let me shine one last time. Let me light up the darkness for you, who I love so dearly.
units.displayText: Even if we all end up as nothing in the end... let me shine one last time. Let me light up the darkness for you, who I love so dearly.

spans.text: Even if we all end up as nothing in the end... let me shine one last time. Let me light up the darkness for you, who I love so dearly.

units.rawText: Hubble...
units.displayText: Hubble...

spans.text: Hubble...

units.rawText: Just let me stay by your side like this, until everything fades away.
units.displayText: Just let me stay by your side like this, until everything fades away.

spans.text: Just let me stay by your side like this, until everything fades away.

units.rawText: I'd gladly forget everything else, as long as I can remember this one oath and my love for you in this moment...
units.displayText: I'd gladly forget everything else, as long as I can remember this one oath and my love for you in this moment...

spans.text: I'd gladly forget everything else, as long as I can remember this one oath and my love for you in this moment...

units.rawText: Your memories, our oaths, I won't let you forget any of it. Trust me, I'll take care of everything.
units.displayText: Your memories, our oaths, I won't let you forget any of it. Trust me, I'll take care of everything.

spans.text: Your memories, our oaths, I won't let you forget any of it. Trust me, I'll take care of everything.

units.rawText: But now... we have more important matters...
units.displayText: But now... we have more important matters...

spans.text: But now... we have more important matters...

units.rawText: Hubble's inner anxiety and deep emotions radiates through her body heat. Suddenly remembering something, I gently wrap my arm around her waist and lift her up, cradling her horizontally.
units.displayText: Hubble's inner anxiety and deep emotions radiates through her body heat. Suddenly remembering something, I gently wrap my arm around her waist and lift her up, cradling her horizontally.

units.rawText: Huh?
units.displayText: Huh?

spans.text: Huh?

units.rawText: You've been in the church all night. You couldn't have slept comfortably. Now that our oath ceremony is over, you should head back to the dorm and get some proper rest.
units.displayText: You've been in the church all night. You couldn't have slept comfortably. Now that our oath ceremony is over, you should head back to the dorm and get some proper rest.

units.rawText: And what about you?
units.displayText: And what about you?

spans.text: And what about you?

units.rawText: Hehe, I slept very well yesterday, no need to...
units.displayText: Hehe, I slept very well yesterday, no need to...

spans.text: Hehe, I slept very well yesterday, no need to...

units.rawText: Aren't you coming along, Professor?
units.displayText: Aren't you coming along, Professor?

spans.text: Aren't you coming along, Professor?

units.rawText: Is this... an invitation? My heart suddenly races. Before I can fully process our previous conversation, Hubble's hands are already reaching out towards me.
units.displayText: Is this... an invitation? My heart suddenly races. Before I can fully process our previous conversation, Hubble's hands are already reaching out towards me.

units.displayText: Her fingers gently caresses my cheek. The subtle, almost imperceptible touch makes my heart tingle.

spans.text: Her fingers gently caresses my cheek. The subtle, almost imperceptible touch makes my heart tingle.

units.rawText: What if I wake up tomorrow and can't remember the oath I made to you?
units.displayText: What if I wake up tomorrow and can't remember the oath I made to you?

spans.text: What if I wake up tomorrow and can't remember the oath I made to you?

units.rawText: Don't worry. I'll tell you about it and perform the oath ceremony for you again, or...
units.displayText: Don't worry. I'll tell you about it and perform the oath ceremony for you again, or...

spans.text: Don't worry. I'll tell you about it and perform the oath ceremony for you again, or...

units.rawText: Hubble gently places a finger on my lips.
units.displayText: Hubble gently places a finger on my lips.

spans.text: Hubble gently places a finger on my lips.

units.rawText: I don't want it to be like that, Professor. Instead, why don't you rest beside me at night? When I wake up and you're the first thing I see, I'll know you're the person closest to me.
units.displayText: I don't want it to be like that, Professor. Instead, why don't you rest beside me at night? When I wake up and you're the first thing I see, I'll know you're the person closest to me.

spans.text: I don't want it to be like that, Professor. Instead, why don't you rest beside me at night? When I wake up and you're the first thing I see, I'll know you're the person closest to me.

units.rawText: Perhaps this way, I won't forget.
units.displayText: Perhaps this way, I won't forget.

spans.text: Perhaps this way, I won't forget.

units.rawText: A mischievous smile appears on the girl's face.
units.displayText: A mischievous smile appears on the girl's face.

spans.text: A mischievous smile appears on the girl's face.

units.rawText: Now that you have chosen me, please follow me into darkness together... We'll wander through dreams, intertwined... Your essence within me, and mine within you...
units.displayText: Now that you have chosen me, please follow me into darkness together... We'll wander through dreams, intertwined... Your essence within me, and mine within you...

spans.text: Now that you have chosen me, please follow me into darkness together... We'll wander through dreams, intertwined... Your essence within me, and mine within you...

units.rawText: Heh, it seems I may have bitten off more than I can chew.
units.displayText: Heh, it seems I may have bitten off more than I can chew.

spans.text: Heh, it seems I may have bitten off more than I can chew.

units.rawText: Didn't you say that once you've made a promise, there's nothing you wouldn't do to keep it?
units.displayText: Didn't you say that once you've made a promise, there's nothing you wouldn't do to keep it?

spans.text: Didn't you say that once you've made a promise, there's nothing you wouldn't do to keep it?

units.rawText: I gently kissed her forehead, answering her question.
units.displayText: I gently kissed her forehead, answering her question.

spans.text: I gently kissed her forehead, answering her question.

units.rawText: Of course.
units.displayText: Of course.

spans.text: Of course.

units.rawText: I no longer fear losing my path... for this ray of starlight, gifted by my Professor, is forever etched in my mind.
units.displayText: I no longer fear losing my path... for this ray of starlight, gifted by my Professor, is forever etched in my mind.

spans.text: I no longer fear losing my path... for this ray of starlight, gifted by my Professor, is forever etched in my mind.

units.displayText: Even if all else sinks into oblivion, the oath we've exchanged in this moment will endure as the final spark of light.

spans.text: Even if all else sinks into oblivion, the oath we've exchanged in this moment will endure as the final spark of light.
